entry_before.claim_zh: 以生生为共同根据评价目标、评价者与选择规则；方向论证及相连目标取得、判断、实际修订与有界改革现已成为完成成果，更强理论按明确范围继续。 后续接通改革自身改变实际负担及报告路线、直接取得与保留新目的的修复。
entry_before.claim_en: Appraise ends, evaluators and selection rules through shared generative grounds; the direction argument and connected acquisition, judgment, operative revision and bounded reform are now completed foundations for the broader programme. A further joined case connects reform-induced burdens and reporting changes to acquired correction and repair preserving the new goal.
entry_before.scope_zh: 当前首要方向之一；方向论证及本轮相连机制均已独立验收，不再作为待做接口。新相连结果：27新定理／84新声明审计、46继承审计，13历史／221完整状态；规范采用、对应、权限、有限资金与现实部署范围分明。 本会话后续另增23项定理／43项审计，93项继承定理／165项审计分列；此后续为同作者反审，无新经验验证或独立agent验收。
entry_before.scope_en: A current primary direction. The direction argument and new connected mechanism are independently accepted, not unfinished interfaces. New connection: 27 theorems/84 new and 46 inherited declaration audits, 13 histories/221 full states, with normative adoption, correspondence, authority, finite funding and deployment scope explicit. This session adds a separate 23-theorem/43-audit followup, with 93 inherited theorems/165 audits separately credited; author counterreview, no new empirical or independent-agent acceptance.
